recommendation: Keep the empty external-repo audit commit. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-37666; any future questionnaire-itemControl terminology changes should be made in HL7/fhir-extensions.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core Questionnaire issue for R5 requesting a tab UI control; the final resolution introduced itemControl code tab-container for a group whose child groups are tabs.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites Git 8e7dc99. That commit is present in the FHIR Extension Pack repository as 8e7dc99d2dc04e8643d297d8fb194ec99c7f0925, titled "FHIR-37666 - Added tab-group itemControlCode", and changed input/definitions/multiple/CodeSystem-questionnaire-item-control.xml.
additional_context: The current FHIR core checkout has Questionnaire active, but no active core source file or fhir.ini entry for CodeSystem-questionnaire-item-control, ValueSet-questionnaire-item-control, or StructureDefinition-questionnaire-itemControl. Those artifacts are maintained in the FHIR Extension Pack. The Extension Pack source contains tab-container with display "Tab Container" and the child-group constraints. It uses Questionnaire.item.text as the tab label; core Questionnaire has item.text and no item.title element, so this is consistent with the model and original issue wording despite the resolution's item.title phrase.
reconciliation: No FHIR core source was changed. The relevant source belongs to the external FHIR Extension Pack repository, and that source already implements the requested tab-container code.
